record.body:
## Description

R1: Tracked fixture templates under tests/fixtures/verdict-repo/ (no nested .git) can build a subject with claim-widget.
R2: The affidavit-verdict workflow builds a git repo at that path from the templates before aff verdict.
R3: aff verdict for claim-widget at the built fixture HEAD returns pass.
R4: Pytest requires an explicit fixture-build step and templates, not merely the strings verdict and attest.

## Approach

1. Add template files under tests/fixtures/verdict-repo/ (app.py green, tests/test_widget.py, .affidavit/manifest.json with frozen oracle hash for claim-widget, pytest.ini as needed).
2. Add tests/fixtures/build_verdict_repo.sh that removes any prior .git at that path, git init -b main, configures user, commits the templates, exits non-zero on failure.
3. Insert a workflow step before Run aff verdict that runs the builder.
4. Rewrite test_ci_workflow_runs_verdict_and_attest to assert the workflow invokes the builder and that template/builder paths exist.
5. Do not change affidavit/attestation.py signing semantics.

payload.title: Builder, templates, workflow step, R4 pytest
